programs.title: Shakespeare \u0026 Hathaway: Private Investigators
programs.desc: Frank Hathaway (Mark Benton) is a private detective who constantly follows unsolved mysteries.Together with Luella Shakespeare (Jo Joyner), a hairdresser learning to be a detective, they form an unusual duo that investigates the suspicious affairs of the inhabitants of Warwickshire.However, the beginnings of cooperation are not promising.Frank has to get used to his partner's habits.Over time, they work out a compromise that is good for both sides.They will have to face the mysterious death of the mayor of Arden and must protect the safety of a certain gravedigger.The production combines elements from various British detective series.Luella Shakespeare is played by Jo Joyner, known from the cult film "Eastenders".

programs.title: Midsomer Murders
programs.desc: Another season of the series taking place in England, in Midsomer and its surroundings.Among the eccentric residents there are Chief Inspector Tom Barnaby (John Nettles), calm and persistent in tracking down crimes, husband Joyce (Jane Wymark) and father Cully (Laura Howard).He is assisted by his assistant, Ben Jones (Jason Hughes).Both detectives solve complicated murder cases that take place in the area.What they learn while conducting investigations sometimes exceeds their wildest expectations.
